facts.about: Polycab is India’s leading manufacturers of cables and wires and allied products such as uPVC conduits and lugs and glands. We have a range of cables and wires for practically every application. More recently Polycab has also launched a wide range of consumer electrical products like Fans, Switches, Switchgear, LED lights and Luminaries, Solar Inverters, and Pumps.

flags.text: Cash-rich profits: 5-yr operating cash = 101% of PAT
Receivable days stretched from 32 to 48 in 3 years
Latest quarter growth (+53%) accelerating vs 3-yr trend (+27%)

business.summary: Polycab India Limited manufactures and sells wires, cables, and fast-moving electrical goods (FMEG), and executes electrical infrastructure projects. It generates revenue through domestic and international sales of these electrical solutions across retail, industrial, and institutional sectors.

segments.name: Wires and Cables
segments.note: Leading Indian market player supplying diverse retail, industrial, and institutional customers.

segments.name: Fast-Moving Electrical Goods (FMEG)
segments.note: Delivers innovative electrical solutions to retail and commercial customers across diverse sectors.

segments.name: Engineering, Procurement & Construction (EPC)
segments.note: Executes complex electrical infrastructure projects for government and institutional power customers.

scorecard.promised: Sustain medium- to long-term EBITDA margins within 11% to 13% range.
scorecard.delivered: Achieved 14% in the latest quarter and 14% for the full year FY26.
scorecard.evidence: Margins have consistently stayed at or above the 11-13% range, hitting 14% in Sep 2026 and Mar 2026.

scorecard.promised: Grow at 1.5x to 2x of the industry growth rate.
scorecard.delivered: Revenue grew 52.8% YoY in Sep 2026, accelerating from 39% in Jun 2026.
scorecard.evidence: Latest quarter growth of 53% significantly exceeds the 3-year trend of 27%, indicating strong market share gains.

scorecard.promised: Normalize to a long-term steady range of 45 to 50 days.
scorecard.delivered: Cash conversion cycle stood at 39 days as of Sep 2026.
scorecard.evidence: The 39-day cycle is better than the promised 45-50 day range and significantly improved from 65 days historically.

scorecard.promised: Invest ₹12 billion to ₹16 billion annually through FY30.
scorecard.delivered: Capital work in progress reached ₹1,401 crore by Sep 2026.
scorecard.evidence: 9M FY26 capex of ₹10.9 billion aligns with the annual target of ₹12-16 billion.

scorecard.promised: Targeting EBITDA margins in the range of 8% to 10% by FY30.
scorecard.delivered: EBIT margins for Q1 FY27 were 8%.
scorecard.evidence: Currently at the lower bound of the FY30 target; requires sustained performance to reach the 10% upper limit.

narrative.scoreline: Management has demonstrated high credibility by consistently exceeding margin guidance and accelerating revenue growth while maintaining a lean working capital cycle.

narrativeVsNumbers.claim: The company gained 3% to 4% market share in the domestic wires and cables organized market.
narrativeVsNumbers.reality: Revenue growth accelerated to 52.8% YoY in Sep 2026, supporting the narrative of significant share capture.

narrativeVsNumbers.claim: FMEG segment remained profitable for four consecutive quarters despite high brand investments.
narrativeVsNumbers.reality: FMEG EBIT margins reached 8% in Q1 FY27, confirming the transition to sustained profitability.

narrativeVsNumbers.claim: Working capital is expected to settle within a 45 to 50 day range.
narrativeVsNumbers.reality: The actual cash conversion cycle has outperformed this, dropping to 39 days.

bull: Revenue growth is accelerating, with Sep 2026 growth of 53% YoY far outpacing historical averages.
Cash generation is exceptional, with 5-year operating cash flow representing 101% of reported PAT.
The balance sheet is practically debt-free with a 0.02x debt-to-equity ratio and ₹13,094 crore net worth.
bear: Receivable days have stretched from 32 to 48 days over the last three years, requiring monitoring.
Management anticipates a margin step-down in FMEG to 8-10% long-term compared to current consolidated 14% levels.
Heavy reliance on EPC contract cost estimation and revenue recognition remains a key audit risk.
watch: Commissioning of the EHV plant in FY28 to drive high-voltage segment growth.

risks.text: Contingent liabilities include various disputed tax demands and export obligation commitments on imported capital goods.
Related party transactions are conducted on an arm's length basis in the ordinary course of business.
Auditors identified revenue recognition and EPC contract cost estimation as key audit matters for the company.
